resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source DFT code supporting GGA-PBE)

access.notes: The paper originally used VASP; any GGA-PBE DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT) is acceptable. Needed to compute optimized ferroelectric structure and band structure.

resources.notes: The lattice constants (a=3.991 Å, c=4.035 Å) are from experimental literature and are public.

access.notes: Open-source. Used to construct maximally localized Wannier functions for Ti‑t2g bands and to obtain smooth band velocities.
BoltzWann is open-source; Boltztrap (also open-source) with Wannier interpolation can be used. Required for Boltzmann transport calculations under constant relaxation time approximation.
